pr_title: [action] Consolidate git_branch action logic into git_helper.rb to ensure consistent results
pr_body:
Fixes: #15034 

<!-- Thanks for contributing to _fastlane_! Before you submit your pull request, please make sure to check the following boxes by putting an x in the [ ] (don't: [x ], [ x], do: [x]) -->

### Checklist
- [x] I've run `bundle exec rspec` from the root directory to see all new and existing tests pass
- [x] I've followed the _fastlane_ code style and run `bundle exec rubocop -a` to ensure the code style is valid
- [x] I've read the [Contribution Guidelines](https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] I've updated the documentation if necessary.

### Motivation and Context
<!-- Why is this change required? What problem does it solve? -->
<!-- If it fixes an open issue, please link to the issue here. -->
As reported in #15034, in certain scenarios the `git_branch()` Action would return different results than the `git_helper.rb` method with the same name `Actions.git_branch`.  This was discovered while trouble shooting issues with the `ensure_git_branch()` action.  Instead of maintaining 2 copies of the logic to retrieve the current branch, we should consolidate it into the appropriate helper class.

### Description
<!-- Describe your changes in detail -->
<!-- Please describe in detail how you tested your changes. -->

I simply copied the shared values and logic from `fastlane/lib/fastlane/actions/git_branch.rb` into `fastlane/lib/fastlane/helper/git_helper.rb` and updated the origin to call the updated internal method.

I'll work on resolving the build errors

@janpio it appears moving all of the logic and shared values from the `git_branch` action to the `git_helper.rb` class has broken the tests, while also altering the expected behavior as the convention for the helper class is to return `nil`.  tbh being new to this project I'm not sure why we have actions for git *and* a git helper class.  It would've been easier to just have `ensure_git_branch` call the `git_branch` action instead of the `Actions.git_branch` helper method.

I think i'll await some advice/guidance before I make anymore changes.  I'm not sure what the rules are as it relates to dependencies between actions.

Re the failing tests: 

I think those failing actions are internally using `git_branch`, which is returning `null` now instead of the executed command which is normally returned when using `sh` during tests:

```
       stub_request(:post, "https://api.github.com/repos/fastlane/fastlane/pulls").
         with(:body => "{\"title\":\"test PR\",\"head\":null,\"base\":\"master\"}",
              :headers => {'Accept'=>'*/*', 'Authorization'=>'Basic MTIzNDU2Nzg5', 'Host'=>'api.github.com:443', 'User-Agent'=>'fastlane-github_api'}).
         to_return(:status => 200, :body => "", :headers => {})
```

vs.

```
  stub_request(:post, "https://api.github.com/repos/fastlane/fastlane/pulls").
         with(:body => "{\"title\":\"test PR\",\"head\":\"git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD\",\"base\":\"master\"}",
              :headers => {'Authorization'=>'Basic MTIzNDU2Nzg5', 'Host'=>'api.github.com:443', 'User-Agent'=>'fastlane-github_api'})
```

Note `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD` in there.

If you change
```
return ENV.fetch(env_name.to_s) { `git symbolic-ref HEAD --short 2>/dev/null`.strip }
```
to 
```
return ENV.fetch(env_name.to_s) { Actions.sh("git symbolic-ref HEAD --short 2>/dev/null", log: false).chomp
```
this would probably make sure that the command is returned - although it still might be a different one, so the tests would have to be adapted.

Do `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD` and `git symbolic-ref HEAD --short 2>/dev/null` the same thing?

> I'm not sure what the rules are as it relates to dependencies between actions.

Same here - this is probably also the reason for the helper. If they all use the helper, they are not interconnected but use some common code. We have this for some other bits as well I guess.
@janpio ok I'll take a closer look tonight, but if the right approach is to enhance the helper then the `git_branch` spec needs to be rewritten

> Do git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD and git symbolic-ref HEAD --short 2>/dev/null the same thing?

The latter resolves to HEAD if no named branch is available instead of throwing an error.  I should use it instead.  The behavior is what exposed the differences.  The expanded set of environment variable names in the helper should resolve the original problem.
@joshdholtz Some guidance on the architecture of action vs. helper here please (we talked about this in other contexts recently).

As a workaround to this issue, instead of using the `ensure_git_branch` action, which will not get the correct branch name on non-jenkins CI servers, I just do this:
```ruby
branch = git_branch()
# alternate method of enforcing conventional branch
unless branch =~ /(?i)^(chore|feat|fix|refactor)\/(\w+-\d{2,3})(-\w+)*(?-i)/
  UI.user_error("branch does not match spec, current branch #{branch}")
end
```

Would like to know if I should continue down the path of consolidating use of the additional environment variables into the git helper or do something else.
